review.limitations: Only static typing changes are visible; no tests demonstrate actual float value preservation or failure handling. No migration or compatibility checks shown.
review.reason: Changes are narrow, localized maintenance updates expanding supported data types in batch export configuration. While this could prevent future failures when users attempt to export float properties, the implementation does not show broader systemic capability or risk reduction. Tier 3 requires demonstrated material reach and appropriate validation across components, which is absent. Tier 2 would require a substantive correctness improvement beyond type widening; here it remains bounded and localised.
review.posthog_relevance: Relevant to PostHog's Batch Export feature, potentially enabling correct export of event properties stored as numbers rather than strings.
review.uncertainty: Could be higher if runtime behavior and test results showed successful float support without regression, but only declarations change.
